headline: EU Rejects Plea to Pause Troubled EES Biometrics System at Airports Ahead of Summer Rush
context: E.U. leaders rebuffed a plea from the aviation industry to pause the biometric checkpoints, which have caused long lines and missed flights. Summer travelers beware.

sources.name: The New York Times
